title: 经济高效的数学证明自动评判
summary: 该研究探讨使用廉价开源模型评判自然语言数学证明。在IMO-GradingBench上，三个廉价评判模型与人类判断的一致性不逊于前沿模型，成本低100倍。推荐使用全三通过规则，但需独立验证。
summary_en: This research explores using cheap open-weight models to judge natural-language math proofs. On IMO-GradingBench, three cheap judges match frontier models in agreement with human decisions at up to 100x lower cost. The all-three-pass rule is recommended but needs independent replication.
